caseName: Lynch v. Nashville, Chattanooga & St. Louis Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Carter Lynch, Trustee in Bankruptcy of the Tennessee River Coal Company v. Nashville, Chattanooga and St. Louis Railway Company
attorneys: Messrs. Frank Spurlock and Fitzgerald Hall for defendants in error, in support of the motion. Mr. Charles C. Moore for plaintiff in error, in opposition thereto.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of section 237 of the Judicial Code as amended by the act of September 6, 1916, e. 448, sec. 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v.

Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
